{{Quote|My partner Zinny and I train and supply bounty hunters. Got a little area to test out new gear, the whole bit.|Xenteel|<ref name="Tools" />}}
'''Zinny''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] who worked as a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. During the war she worked on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]] with a [[Human/Legends|Human]] named [[Xenteel]]. The pair worked out of an industrial town named [[Jiguuna]] where provided training and supplies for other bounty hunters and had a stall set up in the town's market area. Xenteel directed a [[Hunter (individual)|bounty hunter]] who was hoping to take part in the [[Great Hunt (competition)|Great Hunt]] to Zinny for training during their time on Hutta. Zinny ultimately taught a number of tricks to the hunter.

==Biography==
{{Quote|I never miss my mark. You won't either, if you listen.|Zinny|<ref name="Tools" />}}
Zinny was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] who lived during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].<ref name="Tools" /> By the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TOR_dates|1}}</ref> she had taken up a career as a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] and had become talented enough at the job to teach others in the art of bounty hunting. The Twi'lek teamed up with a [[Human/Legends|Human]] named [[Xenteel]] and the pair began a business of training and supplying other bounty hunters, using their own experience. Zinny and her partner set up a stall for their business and an area to test weapons both on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]],<ref name="Tools" /> the adopted [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="CodexHutta">{{TORcite|type=codex|Hutta}}</ref> The stall and was in the market area of an industrial town named [[Jiguuna]],<ref name="Tools" /> which was controlled by a Hutt [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] named [[Suudaa Nem'ro]].<ref name="CodexJiguuna">{{TORcite|type=codex|Jiguuna}}</ref> Whilst at her stall Zinny often watched [[Hologram/Legends|holograms]] of various individuals using a small device capable of projecting a life size hologram of the humans on to the ground in front of the bounty hunter. The individuals spoke during the duration of the projection, although Zinny did not reply to them.<ref name="Tools" />

[[File:Zinny_stall.png|thumb|left|Zinny at her stall in Jiguuna.|250px]]

{{GameMechanics|legends=1}}
In the same [[Standard year/Legends|year]], a [[Hunter (individual)|bounty hunter]] was directed to Zinny by Xenteel. Her partner had recognized the individual as an affiliate of another bounty hunter named [[Braden]], whilst in the [[Poison Pit]] [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]]. Zinny taught the hunter, who hoped to compete in the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] bounty hunting contest known as the [[Great Hunt (competition)|Great Hunt]], a number of bounty hunting tricks and skills for a small fee.<ref name="Tools" />
{{EndGame}}

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Use my tricks, you'll get the fat bounties and the big pay.|Zinny|<ref name="Tools" />}}
Zinny was considered an experienced bounty hunter during the time of the Cold War and knew enough about tricks, weapons, and maneuvers to be able to teach others members of the profession. She charged a fee of [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] to those she taught and often claimed that with what she taught them they would be far more successful. Zinny had [[Color/Legends|green]] skin and brown [[Eye/Legends|eyes]].<ref name="Tools" />

==Equipment==
Whilst waiting at her stall for customers Zinny wore grey-colored [[Armor/Legends|armor]] and a brown headpiece. Her gear included a device that could project a green holographic screen on her right wrist and a wrist-mounted flamethrower on her left wrist, which she occasionally tested. She wore a [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]] on her belt and kept a [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]] and a tool kit at the stall whilst she was there. The Twi'lek also possessed a device a floating capable of projecting a holographic image of a life size Human.<ref name="Tools" />

==Behind the scenes==
Zinny first appeared in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' which was released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]]. In the game Zinny is located on Nal Hutta which is the starting planet for players of the bounty hunter and [[Imperial Agent]] class. Her role within the game is that of a class trainer for players of the bounty hunter class and she will teach them new usable skills, with what skills are available being dependent on the player's level. She is also involved in the quest "Tools of the Trade" in which bounty hunters are directed to Zinny to learn their first class skills. Although not identified by name, Zinny's location as a class trainer in Jiguuna is marked on the Nal Hutta map in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Explorer's Guide]]'' a book released at the same time as the game.
